audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Kled 4/7 stages; the already-audited mirror (karma__kled) locked the chart as Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Kled. Both layers disagreed with the mirror on rows 1,2,3,4,5.
audit.why: The two directions must never contradict; mirror-fix.js would overwrite. The existing whys already describe Karma winning those stages, so only the side tokens and ratings were out of step.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped in both layers to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Kled with ratings re-scaled 3/3/4/4/5/4/6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named no real cooldowns; level-6 and first-item phase text was generic.
audit.why: CHAAAARGE is 140/125/110s at 3500/4000/4500 range; Inner Flame is 9/8/7/6/5s; Focused Resolve is a flat 12s; Mantra 40/38/36/34s. Concrete numbers make the sequencing advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Phase whys at Levels 4-5, 6 and First item rewritten around the 12s Focused Resolve, the 140s R and her first-item poke range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Karma's Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals her, so extended trades were mispriced. Itemization carried no Grievous Wounds line.
audit.why: Karma W text: 'Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.' Kled's Jousting (E) is a dash, so her root is the peel that denies the re-dash; Bear Trap (Q) is a projectile and costs 0 mana on an 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling added to itemization with the reason (Mantra-W heal); phase and Don't text keyed to Focused Resolve's 12s window.

audit.why: Focused Resolve on a flat 12s at every rank is the punishable window and the text already tracks it.

edits.before: Q beartrap is the kill switch — land it and rip the combo. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Inner Flame poke still out-ranges you; Bear Trap is the kill switch, but step up only once Focused Resolve (12s) is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but one Inspire shield peels a level-3 commit. Keep the wave your side so Karma must walk into Jousting range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She chips Skaarl with Inner Flame every 7s and kites your re-E; trade only on Focused Resolve's 12s cooldown and bank small leads.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: CHAAAARGE (140s) closes her root spacing and shields you — even, since a saved Mantra shield or root still answers your commit.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first-item Inner Flame poke out-ranges Eclipse — commit only on Focused Resolve.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the all-in sustain), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Eclipse, then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Add Executioner's — Mantra-W heals her.

notes: Chart aligned to the already-audited mirror karma__kled. The content-layer whys already described Karma winning stages 1-3 and 5 and 'Even' at 6, so only the side tokens were desynced — the prose needed no flip. diff FAV / diffRating 7.5/10 sits oddly against Karma taking 5/7 stages, but the mirror auditor deliberately left diff untouched, so I did the same rather than desync the two sides.
